verdict.rationale: Tilled documents per-merchant pricing templates letting ISVs set custom pricing per seller (tilled-docs-9, tilled-docs-21), which supports markup/monetization by merchant, but there's no evidence of an explicit application-fee mechanism or a dashboard/report that separates platform revenue from processing costs. missing for 10: explicit application-fee/markup API or setting, and a dedicated revenue-vs-cost reporting view.
